constraints.explanation: the threads alternate warp and weft, so an even number of them closes on the tile
the sag and the threads together fit inside the height range

controls.explanation: The stripes, in order across the tile, repeating.
controls.label: Stripe colours

controls.explanation: What the cloth fades toward where the sun has bleached it.
controls.label: Bleached colour

controls.explanation: The grime rain leaves running down the slope.
controls.label: Dirt colour

controls.explanation: How many stripes fit across one tile, along the shopfront.
controls.label: Stripes across

controls.explanation: How many threads fit across one tile; more means finer cloth.
controls.label: Thread size

controls.explanation: How far a thread stands above the crossing beside it.
controls.label: Thread relief

controls.explanation: How much a thread on top is lighter than the one beneath it.
controls.label: Thread tone

controls.explanation: How many dips the cloth makes across one tile, one to a rafter.
controls.label: Sag ripples

controls.explanation: How far the cloth dips between two frame bars.
controls.label: Sag depth

controls.explanation: The most the sun has bleached the cloth, in percent.
controls.label: Sun fading

controls.explanation: How many patches of fading fit across one tile; more means smaller patches.
controls.label: Fade patches

controls.explanation: The most the streaks left by running rain darken the cloth, in percent.
controls.label: Rain streaks

controls.explanation: How many streaks fit side by side across one tile.
controls.label: Streak spacing

controls.explanation: How many streak lengths fit down one tile; fewer means longer streaks.
controls.label: Streak length

controls.explanation: How matte the cloth is, in thousandths.
controls.label: Canvas roughness

controls.explanation: How much a streak of dirt dulls the cloth, in percent.
controls.label: Dirt roughness

controls.explanation: Millimetres between the lowest and highest point the height map can hold.
controls.label: Height range

controls.explanation: How far around each point the surface is compared to find crevices.
controls.label: Occlusion radius

controls.explanation: How far below its surroundings a point must sit to be fully shadowed.
controls.label: Occlusion depth

controls.explanation: The darkest a crevice can get, in thousandths.
controls.label: Occlusion strength
